what: The standing overlaps between the offline brain's regexes and the eval generator's templates (BUG-210).
why: The parser was written from the generator's own templates, so scoring intent on the gold text measures the parser's coverage of its own template set. The number is reported as a ceiling; the headline number stays unmeasured until the held-out set exists (FOUNDER_TODO).

overlaps.pattern: ^(?:cannot get in|can't get in|locked out|no access)\s+at\s+(?P<address>.+)$
overlaps.note: the parser spells out the eval generator's template: the intent number on this shape is a ceiling, not a held-out accuracy
